chapter_seo_title: RMJI Ch 17: Senior Brother Li Arrives – Fierce Blade, Crowd Roars
chapter_meta_description: Han Li watches a sparring match as Little Abacus flatters him and explains the Seven Mysteries Sect's rigid social ladder. The final bout brings Senior Brother Li and his legendary blade into the ring.
og_title: RMJI Ch 17 – The Galloping Thunder Blade
og_description: Little Abacus probes Han Li's true status while two fighters clash in the arena. The arrival of Senior Brother Li changes everything.
